device_entry.name: PWM转向控制组件
tags: 移动机器人与自动驾驶实验
device_entry.description: 用于输出转向通道PWM信号的控制组件，服务于移动平台或车辆类系统的方向控制。
device_entry.description_en: A control component for steering-channel PWM output, used for direction control in mobile platforms or vehicle-like systems.

schema.description_en: Update the PWM steering control state.

schema.description_en: Compute and output the corresponding PWM steering pulse from the requested steering angle in threaded mode.

schema.description: 根据输入转向角计算并输出对应的PWM转向脉冲。
schema.description_en: Compute and output the corresponding PWM steering pulse from the requested steering angle.

schema.description: 关闭时将转向设置回直行位置。
schema.description_en: Set the steering back to the straight-ahead position during shutdown.
